item.title: Interior work advances at new Dawson Creek hospital amid search for ER art
item.description: Northern Health has called on local artists to submit expressions of interest to design a sculpture for the outside of the new Dawson Creek and District Hospital's emergency department.

item.description: The Fort St. John Senior Flyers will face the Dawson Creek Canucks in the 2025/26 playoffs.

item.title: Fort St. John RCMP search for missing 16-year-old girl
item.description: Fort St. John RCMP officers are looking for Kiyara Blue, 16, who has not been heard from since the morning of February 5th.

item.title: City overspends by nearly $500K on 2025 snow clearing after near-record December weather
item.description: The City of Fort St. John council went overbudget for snow clearing by almost $500,000 in 2025 after near-record snowfall in December.

item.title: BC Hydro celebrates bear tracks at new wetland on former Site C construction land
item.description: BC Hydro says the wetland near Site C features dense rushes and native plant growth where bare soil and debris sat a year before.
